{{Quote|Interested in some target practice? Simple, big reward from upstairs and the targets aren't even moving. The Republic's scattered gun turrets along the defensive line, and my forces can't break through.|Tulsar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tulsar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the fighting in the [[Sundari Flatlands]], Tulsar's forces were unable to advance due to the presence of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] gun turrets along their defensive line, so Tulsar recruited additional forces to take out the turrets.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Tulsar starts the mission "On the Line" for players on the Imperial version of Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
